name: internhub
description: InternHub — Full-stack internship discovery & application platform monorepo
author: VALLURI RAHUL <https://valluri-rahul-portfolio.vercel.app/>

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix backend && npm run lint:fix --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix backend && npm run format:check --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
